# Missing Configuration File Handling

If the configuration file (kc.toml) is missing in the provided repository directory, the CompileError exception is raised, interrupting the compilation process without any recovery plan for guiding the user.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
